Tuition 3,200 EUR/semester is stated for both EU/EEA and non-EU/EEA students on the programme page. The quote 'The application starts in the online application system (apply.elte.hu).' names the university's own portal (hu-university-direct); no Stipendium Hungaricum application route is stated for this programme's admission. Some other pages supplied (Student Finance, calls for applications, additional financial support) do not add facts for this programme.
